# Ideator Labs

> Ideator Labs is an early-stage product studio and AI and data advisory: we build ready-to-run software for one sector at a time, and help firms put AI and data to work through a fixed-fee advisory service.

Sectors we work in today: furniture retail (FurniTrail), accounting and CA firms (advisory), and D2C brands (advisory). Next sectors are picked one at a time.

## Products

- [Products](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/): Overview of what Ideator Labs builds and researches.
- [FurniTrail by Ideator Labs](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/furnitrail/): Software for furniture showrooms, being built and not launched yet. It captures walk-in visitors, sends each a shortlist link with 3 options, lets them view pieces in 3D, follows up on WhatsApp and gives the owner a daily summary. Early access by request.
- [Reflex](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/#reflex): Research. An open concept for a self-running data engine with five stages: declare, plan, run, heal, learn. A concept only.
- [PollenRev](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/products/pollenrev/): Sales and marketing software for small and mid-sized businesses. Finds leads, scores them against your ideal customer, writes outreach, proposals and pitch decks, and tracks deals in a pipeline. Private beta.

## Advisory

- [Advisory](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/solutions/): Starts with a free 25-minute call, then a fixed-fee diagnostic that finds where a business loses time or margin and what to fix first, then an optional build. Method: VALUE OS (Baseline, Diagnose, Quantify, Design, Drive). If the diagnostic finds nothing worth fixing, we say so plainly. Fees are not published.
- [Sectors](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/industries/): The sectors we work in today and how to suggest the next one.

## Journal

- [Ideator Journal](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/journal/): Plain-language articles on where firms lose time and margin, and how AI and data can help.
- [Where CA firms lose hours every week, and how AI gives them back](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/ca-firms-reclaim-hours-with-ai.html): GST matching, document chasing, re-typing and month-end reports, and how to automate one task at a time.
- [Your D2C brand's real problem isn't ads, it's true margin per order](https://ideatorlabs.github.io/blog/d2c-true-margin-per-order.html): How to work out what each order really earns after all costs before scaling ad spend.
